blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. The same asymmetry appears in PDF. Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
An enterprise agent deployed in the wild does not read documents; it reads whatever an ingestion
layer hands it. Before it can answer a compliance question, follow an operating procedure, or decide
whether an action is permitted, some converter has turned a .docx or PDF into tokens. That
layer is rarely the object of study, and it is where a large amount of an agent’s practical
reliability is decided.

blocks.en:
The failure we report is a property of that layer, and it has the shape that makes agent deployments
hard to trust. It is not an outage and not an empty field. The pipeline reports success, the text
looks complete, and the agent answers fluently and wrongly. Enterprise authors mark obligations
visually—a red requirement, a highlighted exception, a struck-through value that no longer
applies—and every mainstream converter we tested discards that layer while preserving the words
around it. An agent reading the result sees a list of requirements with no indication which ones the
author flagged, and, as we show, it guesses.

blocks.en:
Three properties make this a safety-relevant ingestion problem rather than a formatting
inconvenience. First, it is silent : nothing in the pipeline signals that information was
dropped, so no monitor fires. Second, it inverts the usual failure mode: the agent does not
abstain or return less, it asserts more, and its false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag rises fourfold. Third, it is common , present in about a third of real
documents, so it is not an adversarial edge case but the ordinary state of enterprise corpora.

blocks.en:
The setting is demanding in ways that compound this. Enterprise procedural documents span 50–300
pages and mix formal definitions, step-by-step procedures, compliance rules, exception clauses,
organisational charts, decision flowcharts, timelines and regulatory references—content whose
semantics a human reader partly reconstructs from presentation rather than from wording. Documents
are long enough that fixed-chunk ingestion fragments cross-references a reader resolves globally;
content is heterogeneous, and several kinds of it (headers, footnotes, tracked revisions) are
unreachable from a naive document walk; and authoring conventions are inconsistent, so the same
visual device means different things across departments and must be interpreted rather than mapped
one-to-one. Stated concretely, the problem is to produce a representation of such a document that a
model can read without losing what the author encoded visually , and that is faithful, complete
and economical enough to fit a context window.

blocks.en:
This paper aims to contribute on three fronts. We quantify what formatting-blind ingestion
costs an agent downstream, on real documents and against ground truth taken from the file’s own
markup rather than from our judgement, and we show the effect holds across six answering models from two vendors. We localise it: a span-level leave-one-out over six cue classes
attributes essentially the whole effect to colour and highlighting, with bold, italic, monospace and
strikethrough contributing nothing measurable—which turns “formatting matters” into a specific,
actionable claim about the two cues no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark
scores. And we ask whether recovering a cue is enough, or whether an agent also needs to be told what
the cue means ; a pre-registered test says the latter, though the margin is modest and we
report it as such. Alongside these we release a validated evaluation instrument: labels derived from
OOXML run properties, scored deterministically with no LLM judge, checked against rendered page
images through an independent modality, and bounded above by a supervised text-only classifier so
that the task’s cue-dependence is measured rather than asserted. We also report what did not work,
since both bear on how such systems should be built: progressive disclosure did not reduce token
cost, and the typed layer shows no benefit on the two models that attempt the task only sparsely.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Document conversion and benchmarks. A mature toolchain converts documents for agent
consumption: python-docx and docx2python read OOXML directly, mammoth maps
it to HTML, and Docling [ 4 ] , Unstructured [ 16 ] and pymupdf4llm target LLM-ready Markdown. These are evaluated on text accuracy, reading order, tables and
formulas—the axes of OmniDocBench [ 11 ] and ParseBench [ 12 ] —so
character-level presentation sits largely outside that frame. Microsoft’s Office Comprehension
Benchmark [ 10 ] is the first public suite evaluating LLM systems jointly on native Word,
Excel and PowerPoint files, and we evaluate on its Word File-Fidelity track directly
(§ 4.5 ); even there, formatting-dependent items are a minority and none turns on what a
surviving cue means .

blocks.en:
Formatting recognition. The closest refereed work is TexTAR [ 15 ] , an ICDAR
2025 oral recognising textual attributes in document images. It covers precisely four—bold,
italic, underline, strikeout—and neither colour nor highlighting, the two our ablation finds
load-bearing. It also works from images and stops at attribute detection, where we recover cues
from OOXML and PDF geometry, assign semantic roles, and measure the effect on answer correctness.
Layout analysis [ 7 , 18 ] models page geometry, which is
complementary: our documents are text-heavy and their semantics sit in character properties.

blocks.en:
Is emphasis already a machine signal? Two findings bracket the question our ablation
answers. PASTA [ 13 ] steers attention post hoc, motivated by exactly our premise—that
writers “leverage the subtleties of text style, such as bold and italics, to guide the attention of
readers”—reporting a 22 % 22\% average gain for LLAMA-7B. Against it, Dillitzer et
al. [ 2 ] report an attention–performance divergence : emphasis redirects
attention, yet “increased concentration does not inherently improve task accuracy”. Whether gains
come from cue salience or cue typing is exactly what § 4.4 pre-registers. Relatedly, Braun et al. [ 6 ] show prompt-side structure matters,
but manipulate formatting the prompt author controls, not what the document author chose.

blocks.en: 3.1 Formatting as First-Class Signal
blocks.zh: 3.1 格式化为第一级信号

blocks.en:
Parsing is the subject of this paper; the typed extraction and package rendering that consume its
output are summarised in Appendix S5 . The parser reads the .docx file with python-docx and emits a flat sequence of blocks carrying structured formatting annotations,
entirely in code with zero LLM calls. Every contiguous run of text with identical formatting becomes
a FormattingSpan , an immutable record of 12 attributes; eleven high-confidence
formatting-to-semantics mappings then attach SemanticRole hints—red text or red highlight
to critical_warning , any other visible highlight to warning , strikethrough to deprecated , and so on (Table 4 , Appendix S4 ). These are hints , not ground
truth: we deliberately exclude medium-confidence mappings such as green text to status marker,
because a wrong hint biases an agent worse than no hint.

blocks.en: 3.2 Cue Disambiguation and Recovery
blocks.zh: 3.2 分裂和恢复

blocks.en:
Cues are ambiguous and must be resolved before the text reaches an agent, and two of our rules were
corrected during this study after corpus measurement contradicted the initial design. Bold means key_term when only some spans of a block carry it and implicit_heading when the
block is a standalone line under 200 characters and entirely bold. Colour is matched by channel
threshold rather than hex literal, which admits dark reds while excluding orange—though we note
that 99.7 % 99.7\% of red spans in the corpus are exactly #FF0000 , so the tolerance buys less
than expected. Highlight is typed by presence , not hue: our initial rule typed only yellow,
and measurement showed cyan and light-grey highlighting of obligations is common, so any highlight
except WHITE / NONE —which render identically to unhighlighted text—now types as warning . That single correction raised the share of author-marked paragraphs receiving a
salience role from 79.1 % 79.1\% to 97.6 % 97.6\% . Roles attach at block level while spans carry raw
inline markers, and that separation is what makes the salience-versus-typing ablation possible.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en:
Our claim is that a formatting cue carries meaning that survives or is destroyed during
parsing, and that whether it survives changes whether a downstream model answers
correctly. Testing this requires a task whose ground truth is the cue itself rather
than our interpretation of it. We therefore evaluate on three levels: a real-document
task at scale built from OOXML run properties (§ 4.1 – 4.4 ),
an external benchmark whose questions we did not write (§ 4.5 ), and
and a controlled test that the advantage survives an identical downstream pipeline (§ S9 ).

解析,它是否存活 改变一个下游模型答案
对 测试它需要一项任务 其基础真相是提示本身
而不是我们的解释。 因此,我们在三个层面进行评估:
任务由OOXML运行属性构建(§4.1 - 4.4),
外部基准,我们没有写出其问题(第4.5节),
并进行控制试验,以证明这一优势在一条相同的下游管道中生存(§S9)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Corpus, prevalence, and task

blocks.en: We scanned 6,462 real .docx policy documents from a public corpus, named by content SHA-256, detecting cues at OOXML run level so nothing is inferred from wording. Walking the whole package, 32.8 % 32.8\% carry deliberate red text or a non-white highlight and 10.3 % 10.3\% carry one on a sentence expressing a modal obligation—the risk-bearing case; a further 2.6 % 2.6\% carry cues only outside the body, where no baseline we test can see them (Appendix S1 ).

blocks.en:
This supports a real-document task at scale. A policy document contains several
requirement-like sentences; the author marked some (red text or highlight) and left
others unmarked. We ask:

这支持一个规模真实的文档任务. 政策文件包含若干项
类似要求的句子; 作者标记了一些(红色文本或突出显示)并离开
其他没有标记。 我们问:

blocks.en:
List every requirement in this document that the author has singled out for
special attention or elevated priority.

列出本文件中作者为:
特别关注或高度优先。

blocks.en:
Ground truth is the marked set, taken directly from OOXML run properties—never from
judgement. Scoring is set retrieval (precision, recall, F1) with a false-positive rate
measured against real unmarked requirements from the same document, so a system
that lists everything is penalised. Matching is lexical and deterministic: no
LLM judge is involved . A gold requirement counts as retrieved when a run of four
consecutive opening content words appears in the answer. That rule is deliberately
conservative, and we verified it does not depress the numbers: only one of the 332
gold requirements has fewer than four content words and is therefore unmatchable by
construction, giving every arm a recall ceiling of 0.997 0.997 , and no unmarked distractor is
unmatchable at all. Relaxing the rule to a three-word run or 60% content-word overlap
would accept a further 4.8 % 4.8\% of unmatched pairs, but inspection shows most of those are
the looser rule wrongly matching a different requirement that shares boilerplate
wording, so we keep the strict form. Construction requires at least one marked and at least three
unmarked requirements per document, and rejects any document whose marked sentences
are the only ones carrying urgency words. This yields 84 documents (332 marked, 4,192 unmarked distractors); 76–79 are scored in a given run, as a
document is used only when every arm produces a representation under the size cap, so
comparisons stay paired.

Is the task solvable without formatting? We measure this rather than assert

3–5 grams, logistic regression, grouped by document so no fold shares a
document with its training split) to the marked/unmarked labels gives
ROC AUC = 0.664 =0.664 . The two interpretable heuristics a zero-shot reader could actually
use sit at chance: an urgency-keyword rule scores 0.508 0.508 and sentence length 0.492 0.492 . So the wording carries a weak signal recoverable only with supervision on the
labels, and this 0.664 0.664 is a ceiling on any formatting-blind method.

The comparison that isolates preservation from pipeline depth is
docx2python, which preserves character formatting as HTML and is the strongest
baseline throughout. It reaches 0.586 0.586 —far above docling, far below ours, and the + 0.110 +0.110 gap to ours is significant even within this six-arm family

(pHolm = 0.022 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.022).

blocks.en: 4.3 The loss is concentrated in colour and highlight
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 损失集中于颜色和突出

blocks.en:
“Formatting matters” is too coarse a claim to be useful. We localise it with a
per-cue leave-one-out ablation: each arm removes exactly one cue class at the span level and re-derives the semantic roles, so document content is
byte-identical across arms and only that cue’s markers and role token are absent
(Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
“标定事项”索赔过于粗糙,无益。 我们用一个地方化它
ecue leave-one-out ablusion:每个臂部在跨度级完全去除一个提示类,并重划语义角色,所以文档内容是
横跨武器,只有提示标记和角色符号没有。
(图1).

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Loss in per-document macro F1 when exactly one cue class is removed at the span level, with 10,000-resample bootstrap CIs. Dark bars are significant after Holm correction. Colour and highlight account for essentially the entire effect; the other four cues sit within ± 0.003 \pm 0.003 of zero with intervals straddling it.
blocks.zh: 图1:每文档宏F1中的损失,当在跨度水平上完全删除一个提示类时,带有10 000反样靴式CI。 黑条在霍尔姆修正后是显著的. 彩色和亮度基本说明整个效果;其他四个提示位于零的±0.003\pm 0.003之间,间隔为零。

blocks.en:
The entire effect is carried by highlight ( + 0.302 +0.302 , p Holm < 10 − 5 p_{\text{Holm}}<10^{-5} ) and colour ( + 0.262 +0.262 , p Holm = 2 × 10 − 5 p_{\text{Holm}}=2\times 10^{-5} ).
Bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough contribute nothing measurable—each within ± 0.003 \pm 0.003 of zero, with confidence intervals straddling it. This is not because those cues
are absent: a single document carries over a thousand bold markers. It is because they are
too common to be informative. An author who bolds every heading and defined term has
not thereby singled anything out, whereas colouring or highlighting a requirement is a
deliberate, sparing act. Cue typing pays only for cues rare enough to signal intent.

The ablation is also cue-specific , which validates that the manipulation does what it
claims. Removing colour collapses colour-marked documents from 0.699 0.699 to 0.214 0.214 micro F1
while leaving highlight-marked documents at 0.694 0.694 ; removing highlight does the mirror image, 0.659 → 0.128 0.659\to 0.128 , with colour-marked documents unchanged at 0.670 0.670 . Each removal therefore
damages exactly the documents that use that cue and moves the others by at most 0.011 0.011 .

这证明操控会起到什么作用
索赔。 删除彩色崩溃标记文档,从0.699 0.699改为0.214 0.214 微F1
在0.694 0.694 中留下突出标记的文档; 删除突出标记的镜像, 0. 659 → 0.128 0.659\to 0.128, 颜色标记的文档不变, 为 0.670 0.670 (英语). 因此,每次驱逐

blocks.en:
This localisation matters because colour is precisely the cue that mainstream
conversion tools drop and that parsing benchmarks do not score. ParseBench’s
formatting rules cover bold, italic, superscript and strikeout presence, with no rule
type for font colour at all.
blocks.zh:
这种定位很重要,因为颜色正是主流的提示
转换工具下降,而解析基准没有得分。 贝奇的
格式化规则涵盖粗体、斜体、上标和删除存在,没有规则
字体颜色。

blocks.en: 4.4 Does typing add anything beyond preserving?
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 输入是否添加超出保存范围的东西?

blocks.en:
The novel component of this system is not preserving cues—docx2python does that—but
attaching typed roles to them. Isolating that contribution requires comparing our
representation against the same representation with the role tokens removed and
every inline cue marker retained .
blocks.zh:
这个系统的新内容不是保存提示-docx2python这样做-但
将打字的角色附在他们身上。 孤立这种贡献需要比较我们
代表反对同一代表,其作用标志被删除
每个内线提示标记被保留 。

blocks.en:
This effect proved unstable across exploratory runs, for a reason we can name.
Recovering headers, footers, footnotes and document properties (§ 4.5 )
raised the untyped arm from 0.575 0.575 to 0.610 0.610 , shrinking the gap, and enlarging the
arm family made the Holm correction stricter. Only 16 of 76 document pairs were
discordant, so the test was underpowered either way. Rather than re-analyse the same
data with different arm families, we pre-registered a confirmatory design—
hypotheses, three arms, six repeats, test and correction family fixed in advance and
committed to version control before execution.
blocks.zh:
事实证明,这种影响在探索过程中是不稳定的,原因我们可以列举。
恢复页眉、页脚、脚注和文件属性(第4.5节)
将无型臂从0.575 0.575升至0.610 0.610,缩小了差距,扩大了
手臂家族使霍尔姆的矫正更加严格. 76对文件中只有16对
不和谐,所以测试能力不足 无论是哪种方式。 而不是重新分析同样的
我们预先登记了一个确认性设计
假设、三臂、六次重复、测试和矫正家庭预先固定
执行前承诺使用版本控制。

We report that protocol’s execution history in full, because the borderline p p below
depends on it. The design was executed once, then executed a second time, unchanged,
after a defect in our parser was fixed: a table-cell renderer was emitting neutral colour

so every ours representation changed and the earlier numbers could not stand.
Nothing about the hypotheses, arms, repeats, test or correction family was altered. The
pre-fix run gave + 0.084 +0.084 with W/L/T 15 / 2 / 62 15/2/62 and p Holm = 0.005 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.005 ; the post-fix

The correction therefore made our headline p p worse while leaving the effect size

Both hypotheses are supported (Table 1 , lower panel). Typing a preserved

blocks.en: 4.8 Implications for agents deployed in the wild
blocks.zh: 4.8 对野外部署的毒剂的影响

blocks.en: Three consequences follow for anyone running document-consuming agents in production.
blocks.zh: 任何在生产中经营消耗文件剂的人,都会受到三个后果。

blocks.en:
The failure is invisible to standard monitoring. Every arm we tested returns
well-formed output on every document; none raises, none reports missing content. A pipeline
health check, a schema validator, and a token-count sanity check all pass. The only signal is
answer quality on questions whose ground truth lives in the source markup—which is precisely
what an operator does not have. This argues for ingestion-level assertions rather than
output-level monitoring: our own parser now asserts that a recovered cue implies a located span,
and that assertion caught a defect we had already published in a table.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
An enterprise agent reads whatever its ingestion layer produces, and that layer silently discards
the meaning authors encode visually. On 76 real policy documents, recovering the requirements an
author singled out falls from micro F1 0.690 0.690 to 0.150 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors. The failure is the
difficult kind for
autonomy: not an error the pipeline reports, but an agent that answers fluently and wrongly, with
four times the false-positive rate on requirements the author never flagged.

blocks.en:
Limitations. Exposure is common but not universal: a third of documents carry a deliberate
colour or highlight and 10.3 % 10.3\% carry one on an obligation. PDF support requires a usable text layer,
since we do not OCR. The typed layer is robust on three of the six models but shows no benefit on two that attempt the task only sparsely, so it is conditional on the model engaging with the hint. Ground
truth is derived automatically from run properties and validated against rendered pages by an
independent modality ( κ = 0.72 \kappa=0.72 ) but not yet by human annotators, which is the most valuable
addition remaining. The task is unsaturated at recall 0.60 0.60 , and this is genuine difficulty rather
than measurement: the scorer’s structural ceiling is 0.997 0.997 . Our representation costs roughly twice
plain text in tokens, a deliberate trade of context budget for factuality. Absolute micro F1 is stable
only to about ± 0.08 \pm 0.08 across configurations, so every claim rests on paired per-document tests.

blocks.en:
Inline versus standalone bold. Bold triggers key_term or implicit_heading depending on context, and the discriminator is not a
coverage ratio. A block is standalone when its plain text is a single line shorter
than 200 characters. A standalone block whose every span is bold—or whose text is
entirely upper case—becomes implicit_heading ; otherwise a block with some but
not all spans bold becomes key_term . One consequence is worth stating because it
is a genuine gap rather than a design choice: an all-bold paragraph of 200 characters or
more matches neither branch and receives no bold-derived role at all (29 such blocks in a
29,170-block sweep). We considered a character-coverage ratio instead and found it no
better on the threshold sweep, so the simpler standalone test ships.

may be #FF0000 , #C00000 , #CC0000 or a custom hue chosen years
ago. Rather than matching hex literals the parser thresholds the channels, is_red ( r , g , b ) = ( r > 180 ) ∧ ( g < 80 ) ∧ ( b < 80 ) (r,g,b)=(r>180)\wedge(g<80)\wedge(b<80) , which admits dark reds
while excluding orange and maroon. We report one honest deflation of this design: on the
real corpus 99.7 % 99.7\% of red spans are exactly #FF0000 , so the tolerance costs
nothing but buys much less than we expected.

blocks.en:
Highlight is typed by presence, not by hue. Our initial rule typed only yellow
and dark-yellow highlights as warning . Corpus measurement showed this was wrong:
cyan and light-grey highlighting of obligations is common, and those spans reached the
model carrying their raw value with no role attached. The shipped rule therefore types any highlight as warning except WHITE and NONE , which
render identically to unhighlighted text and are not marks at all; a RED highlight
escalates to critical_warning alongside red text. Hue is still preserved in the
serialized output, so a reader that wants to distinguish yellow from cyan can. This change
raised the share of author-marked paragraphs receiving a salience role from 79.1 % 79.1\% to 97.6 % 97.6\% , and it is the single correction with the largest effect on our results.

Roles are attached at block level. A role is computed from the properties of a
block’s spans but recorded on the block, serialized as a tag attribute
( roles="CRITICAL_WARNING" ). Individual spans carry their raw cue markers inline
( [COLOR:#FF0000] , [HIGHLIGHT:YELLOW] , ~~struck~~ ) but not role names. This distinction is what makes
the ablation in § 4.4 possible: removing the roles attribute
leaves every inline marker intact, so cue salience and cue typing can be
varied independently over byte-identical content.

blocks.en: S4.2 Hybrid Serialization Protocol
blocks.zh: S4.2 混合序列化议定书

blocks.en: After parsing, blocks are serialized to an annotated text string for LLM consumption. The serialization design involves three interlocking choices:
blocks.zh: 解析后,块会被序列化为附加说明的文本字符串,用于LLM消耗. 串行设计涉及三个相互交错的选择:

blocks.en: Hybrid Markdown + custom tags. Standard Markdown handles formatting the LLM has seen extensively in pretraining: bold ( **text** ), italic ( *text* ), and strikethrough (˜˜ text ˜˜). For formatting with no Markdown equivalent, we use custom tags: [COLOR:red]...[/COLOR] , [HIGHLIGHT:yellow]...[/HIGHLIGHT] . This hybrid is 15–20% more token-efficient than pure custom-tag serialization while exploiting the model’s Markdown familiarity.
blocks.zh: Hybrid Markdown + 自定义标记. 标准Markdown处理器格式化LLM在预训中已经广泛看到:粗体(**text**),斜体(*text*),以及切换(QQQ文本QQ). 对于没有马克当量的格式化,我们使用自定义标记:[COLOR:red]...[/COLOR],[HIGLLLightT:yallow]...[/HIGLLightT]. 这个混合体在利用模型的Markdown熟悉度的同时,比纯定制塔格系列化更具有15~20 % 的象征性效率.

blocks.en: Structural metadata tags. Every block is wrapped in a structural tag (e.g. [HEADING level=2 style="Heading 2"] , [TABLE has_header=True cols=4] ) carrying document-level metadata that the LLM cannot infer from text alone: which numbered paragraphs are part of an ordered list, which table has a header row, which paragraph sits under a given heading level. Without these, the extraction model would need to re-derive heading hierarchy from font size heuristics, a fragile and error-prone operation. Tag attributes additionally carry fine-grained context—indentation depth, font size, and Word style name. Appendix S14 enumerates the full tag set and attribute encoding.

blocks.en: Appendix S13 details the complete formatting-to-LLM pipeline for all 11 active SemanticRoles: the raw Word attribute, the disambiguation rule applied at parse time, the resulting role, the exact serialization the LLM receives, and the extraction signal that role encodes. Appendix S15 walks a worked parsing example end to end, and Appendix S16 documents the XML-level workarounds required for content python-docx does not natively expose (text boxes, tracked changes, comments, merged cells, OLE objects).

blocks.en:
Two robustness points follow from running at corpus scale. Real documents violate the
specification—one declares a fractional half-point font size, which makes a strict
reader raise and abandon the whole file—so a malformed cue must degrade to “cue
absent”, never to “document unreadable”. And python-docx reconstructs each table row
from the table grid, raising when a vertical merge references a row that supplies no cell
at that offset; we fall back to reading the row’s cells directly from the XML, which loses
merge continuation but preserves the text. Both defects aborted a 6,462-document scan on
first contact.

blocks.en:
For born-digital PDF the same cues must be recovered geometrically, since PDF has no run
properties: a highlight is a filled rectangle drawn behind glyphs, and a strikethrough is
a hairline crossing the glyph midline where an underline sits at the baseline. We
therefore classify from character-level bounding boxes rather than span-level ones—a
span-level comparison fails because the renderer merges struck and live text into a single
span (§ S8 ).

跨度(S8节)。

blocks.en: Appendix S5 System Architecture and Tiering
blocks.zh: 附录S5 系统架构和分级

blocks.en:
The system processes documents in three stages (diagrammed in Figure 3 , Appendix S12 ). Stage 1
(Parse & Serialize) is entirely code-based with zero LLM calls, and is the subject of
this paper: it recovers character-level presentation and emits annotated text. Stage 2
(Extract) and Stage 3 (Render) consume that text and are described in
§ S7 . The separation concentrates LLM reasoning where it adds value—
entity classification, relationship identification, editorial summarization—and keeps
deterministic work in code. Five design principles guide the architecture
(Appendix S12 ), the most consequential being formatting is signal,
not decoration and source-quote provenance .

本文:它恢复字符级演示文稿并发布附加说明的文本。 第2阶段
(摘录)和第3阶段(招标)消耗该文本,并在
第7节。 分离将LLM推理集中在增加价值的地方——
实体分类、关系识别、编辑摘要——并保留
以密码定律 5项设计原则指导建筑
(Appendix S12 ),最大的结果是格式化是信号,
不是装饰和源词的来源。

enterprise document sizes, we note the tiering here and specify it in

faithfulness validation on a 20% sample to 50K, and above that segmentation into up to 16
overlapping ∼ \sim 8K-token chunks merged pairwise, costing 2 ​ N − 1 2N{-}1 calls for N N segments
— 3 at N = 2 N{=}2 , rising to 31 at the maximum. Segments are kept small deliberately so each
call completes inside the service’s ∼ \sim 330 s streaming limit; wall-clock time is 30 seconds
to 8 minutes depending on tier.

A uniform 4K-token chunking alternative would need an estimated 40–80 calls for a
100-page document and would fragment extractions across chunk boundaries; that figure is
analytical, from the chunk count, and not a measured baseline. The tiered design instead
exploits the fact that one long-context call yields globally coherent output, able to
deduplicate and resolve cross-references in a single pass.

blocks.en: Appendix S7 From Representation to Agent-Loadable Knowledge
blocks.zh: 附录S7 从代表到代理可转让知识

blocks.en:
A faithful representation is a means, not an end. Our reference implementation carries it through
two further stages so an agent can load the result directly: one LLM call per document (or per
segment) converts the annotated text into 17 typed entity types joined by 14 relationships under a
mandate that every entity carry a verbatim source_quote , and a content-analysis router
then writes those entities into a five-file progressive-disclosure package in which the entry
point holds operative guardrails and reference material moves to sub-files
(Appendices S13 – S25 ). Document size is handled by tiering
(§ S6 ); embedded diagrams add one vision call per non-decorative image.

部分)将注释文本转换为17个类型,其中14个关系在 a 下加入

only the entry point and the cheat sheet still encounters disproportionately what the author
flagged. § S9 tests whether the Stage-1 advantage survives this pipeline;
generalising it to a measured claim about typed-extraction accuracy would need a benchmark that

blocks.en: Appendix S12 Architectural Design Principles
blocks.zh: 附录S12 建筑设计原则

blocks.en: Five principles guide the system’s architecture:
blocks.zh: 指导联合国系统结构的五项原则:

blocks.en: 1. LLM for reasoning, code for assembly. LLM calls handle tasks requiring judgment (entity classification, relationship inference, editorial summarization). Deterministic tasks (parsing, serialization, rendering, file I/O) remain in code. This minimizes cost, maximizes reproducibility, and reduces non-determinism. 2. Formatting is signal, not decoration. Every formatting attribute (bold, italic, color, highlight, font) is preserved through the pipeline and presented to the LLM as a semantic hint. The pipeline never strips formatting. 3. Source-quote provenance. Every extracted entity must cite a verbatim quote from the source document. This is the primary anti-hallucination mechanism, more effective than any post-hoc validation. 4. Type specificity over generality. Seventeen entity types with distinct schemas produce richer extractions than a generic “extract all entities” approach. A Procedure has steps with actors and deadlines; a Rule has conditions and consequences. These distinctions matter for downstream use. 5. Progressive disclosure over monolithic output. The output is not a single flat document but a tiered package: a lean entry point containing critical guardrails, a quick-reference sheet for common lookups, and typed sub-files loaded on demand. This matches how AI assistants actually consume skill content.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 LLM用于推理,编码用于组装. LLM调用处理需要判断的任务(实体分类,关系推论,编辑总结). 定型任务(parsing,serialization,渲染,文件I/O)仍然在代码中. 这可以最大限度地降低成本,最大限度地实现再生产,减少非定型. 2. 格式化是信号,而不是装饰。 每个格式属性(粗体,斜体,颜色,亮度,字体)通过管道保存,并作为语义提示提交LLM. 管道从不剥离格式. 3. 来源。 每个被提取的实体必须逐字引用来源文件。 这是主要的防卤化机制,比任何后热验证更有效. 4. 类型特异性比一般性。 17个具有不同计划的实体类型产生的提炼比一般的“摘录所有实体”方法更为丰富。 程序有与行为者的步骤和最后期限;规则有条件和后果。 这些区别对下游的使用很重要。 5. 逐步披露单一产出。 输出不是一个单一的平面文档,而是一个分层包:包含关键护栏的倾斜切入点,用于常见浏览的快速参考页,以及按要求加载的子文件. 这与AI助手如何实际使用技能内容相匹配.

blocks.en: Structural metadata tags. Every block is wrapped in a structural tag carrying document-level metadata: • [HEADING level=2 style="Heading 2"] — heading level and Word style name • [TABLE has_header=True cols=4] — table structure hints • [IMAGE type="flowchart" size=45K] — image classification placeholder • [PARAGRAPH roles="CRITICAL_WARNING"] — block-level roles These structural tags encode information the LLM cannot infer from text alone: which numbered paragraphs are part of an ordered list, which table has a header row, which paragraph sits under a given heading level. Without these, the extraction model would need to re-derive heading hierarchy from font size heuristics, a fragile and error-prone operation.

blocks.en: Appendix S17 Why 17 Entity Types?
blocks.zh: 附录S17 为何17个实体类型?

blocks.en: Fewer types (e.g., the 6-type schema common in generic IE) force-fit distinct content into overly broad categories: a Rule with conditions and consequences is fundamentally different from a Procedure with ordered steps, even though both describe “what to do.” The 17-type taxonomy was validated against real enterprise SOPs to ensure each type has clear, non-overlapping trigger signals.
blocks.zh: 较少的种类(例如,通用IE中常见的6型计划) 强力区分内容,分为过于广泛的类别:有条件和后果的规则与有命令步骤的程序根本不同,尽管两者都描述了“该做什么”。 17型分类法对真实的企业SOP进行了验证,以确保每种类型都有清晰,非重叠的触发信号.

blocks.en: Appendix S18 The 12-Point Extraction Mandate
blocks.zh: 附录S18 12点采掘任务

blocks.en: Beyond the obvious “extract all entities” instruction, several rules address specific failure modes observed in early testing:
blocks.zh: 除了显而易见的“摘录所有实体”指示之外,一些规则涉及早期测试中观察到的具体故障模式:

blocks.en: • Read-before-extract : The model must read the entire document before beginning extraction, preventing the common failure mode where entities in later sections are missed because the model starts outputting before fully reading. • Checklist-as-procedure : Checkbox lists are Procedure entities, not Warning entities, even if they contain prohibitions. Without this rule, models frequently misclassify “checklist items to verify” as warnings. • WRONG/CORRECT pattern : When a document presents “Incorrect: X / Correct: Y” examples, these become worked_examples in the type_specific_fields of a Rule entity. Without this rule, the WRONG examples are sometimes extracted as independent factual claims. • Procedural completeness : Sub-steps within a step must be preserved in full. The model must never “summarize” a 12-step sub-procedure into a one-line description. This rule prevents the single most common form of information loss in SOP extraction. • Warnings and prohibitions are highest priority : Even if the surrounding content is low-confidence, a Warning entity with red text and explicit consequences must always be extracted at HIGH confidence.
blocks.zh: • 阅读前摘要: 模型在开始提取前必须读取整个文档,防止常见的故障模式,因为模型在完全读取前开始输出,所以后段的实体会被忽略. • 核对清单-程序:核对清单是程序实体,而不是警告实体,即使它们载有禁令。 如果没有这一规则,模型往往将“核对清单项目”误列为警告。 • 错误/错误模式: 当文档显示“ 不正确: X / 正确: Y ” 实例时, 这些实例成为规则实体类型_ 特定_ 字段中的工作实例 。 没有这一规则,错误的例子有时被提取为独立的事实索赔。 • 程序完整性: 一个步骤内的分步骤必须完全保留。 该模式决不能将12步子程序“概括”成一线描述。 这一规则防止了SOP提取中最常见的单一信息损失形式. • 警告和禁令是最高优先事项: 即使周围的内容是低信心的,在高信心中必须总是提取一个带有红色文字和明确后果的警告实体.

blocks.en: The remaining 7 points of the 12-point mandate cover standard but necessary rules: ALL-CAPS lines as implicit headings, proper Enumeration item extraction (preserve all items verbatim), Scope entity completeness, Metric unit and threshold preservation, cross-reference tracking for relationship extraction, confidence calibration for diagram-derived entities, and deduplication precedence (explicit stated entity wins over diagram-inferred).

blocks.en: Free-form type_specific_fields. The tool use schema intentionally leaves type_specific_fields as a free-form JSON object rather than defining a per-type nested schema. This avoids an excessively deep and brittle tool definition ( > > 200 lines of JSON Schema) while still guiding the model through the system prompt’s per-type field descriptions. The Pydantic model that receives the output validates only the required fields, tolerating per-type variation.

The model is forced to call extract_entities with the full ExtractionResult payload, which Pydantic validates before returning to the pipeline. The agent’s message history is inspected post-call to extract the tool input dict, which is then deserialized into typed Python models.

blocks.en: Appendix S22 Tier 3 Merge: Additional Details
blocks.zh: 附录S22 第三级合并:补充细节

blocks.en: Segmentation walk. The algorithm walks blocks sequentially, accumulating a running token count and starting a new segment when the 8,000-token threshold is exceeded.
blocks.zh: 分块行走. 算法按顺序行走,累积一个运行中的符数,并在超过8000个托肯阈值时开始一个新的段.

blocks.en: Oversized block handling during segmentation. A subtle complication arises with oversized blocks—single paragraphs exceeding 2 × 2\times the overlap budget (i.e., > > 8,000 characters). Including these in the overlap would cause them to dominate the next segment’s context, crowding out the actual boundary content. Such blocks are explicitly excluded from overlap computation via a skip_next_overlap flag, ensuring the overlap consists of the intended preceding context rather than one large anomalous block.
blocks.zh: 在分割过程中超规模的块处理. 一个微妙的复杂情况是,块块过多——单段超过2×2\时,预算重叠(即 > 8 000个字符)。 把这些内容列入重叠部分,会使它们主导下一段的背景,挤出实际的边界内容。 通过跳过_next_overlap旗,这些块被明确排除在重叠计算之外,确保重叠包括原先打算的上下文,而不是一个大反常块。

blocks.en: Restore from originals. After merging, the compact summaries are replaced with full original data by matching merged entity names to original segment entities via case-insensitive string matching. For entities that appeared in multiple segments (cross-segment duplicates), the merge call identifies them as a single entity; the restore step takes the union of all source_quotes arrays and merges type_specific_fields (e.g., unioning steps arrays from both segments ensures no sub-steps are lost during deduplication).
blocks.zh: 从原作恢复. 合并后,通过对大小写不敏感字符串的匹配,将合并的实体名称与原片段实体相匹配,将紧凑摘要替换为完整的原始数据. 对于出现在多个区段(交叉区块重复)的实体,合并调用将它们识别为一个单一实体;恢复步骤将所有源_引用数组合并,并合并类型_特定_域(例如,从两个区块合并的步数组确保除错时不会丢失子步数).

blocks.en: Appendix S23 Why Source-Quote Verification Instead of Mutual Dependency?
blocks.zh: 附录S23 为什么源码-引文核查而不是相互依赖?

blocks.en: The ZOES Mutual Dependency (MD) principle validates (entity, attribute, value) triplets by checking if masking one component allows recovery of the others. MD addresses attribute granularity —ensuring discovered attributes are neither too coarse nor too fine. In our guided-schema extraction, attributes are predefined, so the granularity problem MD solves does not exist. The actual risk is hallucination : the LLM fabricating content not in the source. Source-quote verification targets this risk directly with a simpler prompt and lower cost.
blocks.zh: ZOES相互依存(MD)原则通过检查遮盖一个组件是否允许回收其他组件来验证三胞胎(实体,属性,值). MD地址属性颗粒性——确保发现的属性既不太粗糙也不太细. 在我们的制导-schema提取中,属性是预先定义的,所以颗粒性问题MD解决方案不存在. 实际风险是幻觉 : LLM 编织内容不在源中. 来源引用的核查直接针对这种风险,更快捷、更低的费用。

blocks.en: Listing 5: Multi-file output package structure. Each file serves a distinct cognitive role.

blocks.en: SKILL.md (entry point). Contains the YAML frontmatter, a “How to Use This Skill” section linking to sub-files, and only the action-critical content: scope, prerequisites, exceptions, bare guardrail rules, warnings, and short procedures/enumerations. Strict size target: < < 500 lines. Entities routed to sub-files appear as one-line stubs with a “See docs/X.md ” link.
blocks.zh: SKILL.md(进入点). 包含 YAML 前题, 连接子文件的“ 如何使用此技能” 部分, 仅包含动作关键内容: 范围、 先决条件、 例外、 赤裸的护栏规则、 警告、 短的程序/ 编号 。 严格大小目标: < 500行。 连接到子文件的实体以“见Docs/X.md.”链接的单行根显示。

blocks.en: QUICK_REFERENCE.md (auto-generated cheat sheet). Auto-generated from all Warning entities and high-severity Rule entities. Contains severity annotations, consequence statements, and mitigation guidance. Only generated when such entities exist. This file is the first reference an AI assistant should consult—it surfaces the most operationally critical constraints without requiring navigation into deeper sub-files.
blocks.zh: QUICK_REFERENCE.md(自动生成的欺骗表). 从所有警告实体和高度规则实体自动生成. 载有严重程度说明、后果说明和缓解指导意见。 只有在存在这种实体时才产生。 这个文件是AI助理应该查阅的第一个参考文献——它显示出最关键的操作限制,而不需要导航到更深的子文件.

blocks.en: docs/ sub-files (full reference content). Each sub-file uses the same hierarchy-aware rendering as SKILL.md but with full entity content: complete procedure steps with actor annotations, full enumeration tables with attribute columns, metric formulas and targets, glossary terms and definitions. Sub-files are loaded on demand, keeping the main context window lean.
blocks.zh: docs/ sub- files (完整参考内容). 每个子文件使用与SKILL.md相同的层次意识渲染,但内容完整:完整的程序步骤有演员说明,完整的盘点表有属性列,度量公式和目标,词汇术语和定义. 子文件按要求加载,使主上下文窗口保持倾斜.

blocks.en: references/provenance.json. Maps every entity ID to its source quotes, source section path, and extraction confidence. Enables complete auditability: any AI-generated statement derived from the skill can be traced to a verbatim source passage.
blocks.zh: 参考文献/证明. json. 将每个实体的ID映射到其来源引用,源段路径,以及提取信心. 启用完整的可审计性:任何从技能中衍生出来的AI生成的语句都可以追溯到逐字记录源段落.

blocks.en: Appendix S26 Anthropic-Spec Description Generation

blocks.en: The SKILL.md YAML frontmatter requires a description field that the Anthropic skill specification calls “pushy”—it must use imperative trigger language to combat undertriggering (the failure mode where the AI assistant possesses the skill but fails to load it because the user’s query doesn’t explicitly mention the skill name).
blocks.zh: SKILL.md YAML 前题需要一个描述字段,Anthropic技能规格称为“pushy ” ——它必须使用必备的触发语言来对抗低调(由于用户的查询没有明确提到技能名称,AI助手拥有技能但未能加载技能的失败模式).

blocks.en: The description generation algorithm uses a three-tier fallback:
blocks.zh: 描述生成算法使用三级倒计时:

blocks.en: 1. Audience + entity trigger keywords (primary) : Extract applies_to from the Scope entity as audience context. Collect up to 5 Procedure , Rule , and Warning entity names as trigger keywords. Format: ‘‘For {audience}. Use this skill whenever users ask about {entity_names}.’’ 1 1 1 Entity names from the document are preferred over applies_to as triggers because they match the vocabulary users employ when asking questions (“How do I reset a password?”) rather than the document’s audience description (“IT Support team handling end-user requests”). 2. SCOPE entity summary (fallback) : If no Scope entity has applies_to , use the scope entity’s LLM-generated summary as the description. 3. Domain + high-confidence entity names (last resort) : Use the document title plus names of HIGH-confidence Definition , Rule , and Procedure entities.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 观众+实体触发关键词(主) : 摘录作为受众背景适用于“范围”实体。 收集最多5个程序、规则和警告实体名称作为触发关键词。 格式 : {为{听众} 。 当用户询问 {实体_names}. } 时使用此技能 1 1 1 文件的实体名称比起触发器优先,因为它们与提问时使用的词汇(“我如何重设密码?”)而不是文件的受众描述(“IT支助小组处理最终用户请求”)相匹配。 2. blocks.en: Appendix S28 Open-Schema Discovery
blocks.zh: 附录S28 开放计划 发现

blocks.en: The 17-type taxonomy covers approximately 95% of enterprise SOP content. For novel document types containing structures outside the taxonomy (e.g., escalation matrices, audit checklists), the system supports an optional open-schema discovery mode inspired by ZOES’s Root Attribute Induction [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 17型分类法涵盖大约95%的企业SOP内容. 对于包含分类外结构的新文档类型(如升级矩阵,审计核对表),系统支持受ZOES的根属性导[19]启发的可选开放-schema发现模式.

blocks.en: The approach uses a two-pass prompt strategy: Pass 1 adds the instruction “if you encounter structured information that does not fit any of the 17 types, create a new type with a descriptive name and define its schema” to the standard extraction prompt. If novel types are discovered, Pass 2 re-extracts with the expanded taxonomy to ensure consistent application across the entire document.
blocks.zh: 该方法采用双通过即时策略:Pass 1在标准提取提示中添加指令“如果遇到不符合17种类型中任何一种结构化信息,创建一种带有描述性名称的新类型,并定义其计划”。 如果发现新颖类型,Pass 2与扩展分类法重排,以确保整个文档的一致应用.

blocks.en: Appendix S29 Conflict Resolution
blocks.zh: S29 解决冲突

blocks.en: When the source document contains contradictory information (e.g., “probationary period is 90 days” in Section 1 vs. “60 days for part-time employees” in Section 7), the system: (1) flags the entity with a conflict marker, (2) preserves both values with source citations, (3) adds an entry to a dedicated “Conflicts & Ambiguities” section in the output, and (4) lowers the entity’s confidence. The system never silently resolves contradictions—that decision belongs to a human reviewer.
blocks.zh: 当来源文件包含相互矛盾的信息(例如,第1节中的 " 试用期为90天 " ,第7节中的 " 非全时雇员60天 " )时,系统:(1) 用冲突标记标出实体的标记,(2) 用来源引证保留两个数值,(3) 在产出中增加一个 " 冲突与敌意 " 专栏,(4) 降低实体的信心。 该系统从不无声地解决矛盾——该决定属于人审查者。

blocks.en: Appendix S30 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录S30 执行详情

blocks.en: Architecture and dependencies. The system is implemented as a Python 3.12+ package comprising ∼ \sim 1,800 lines of production code across 10 modules. The largest modules are: llm/prompts.py ( ∼ \sim 763 lines, extraction + merge + validation prompts), rendering/skill_renderer.py ( ∼ \sim 1,100 lines, entity routing and multi-file rendering), and llm/extraction.py ( ∼ \sim 630 lines, tier orchestration, segmentation, and binary merge).
blocks.zh: 建筑与依附关系. 该系统作为Python 3.12+软件包实施,由 \\sim 1800行生产代码组成,跨越10个模块. 最大的模块是: llm/prompts.py(\\sim 763行,提取+合并+验证提示),渲染/skill_reswer.py(\sim 1100行,实体路由和多文件渲染),以及 llm/extraction. py(\\sim 630行,分层管弦,分层,和二进制合并).

blocks.en: The five runtime dependencies are: python-docx ( ≥ \geq 0.8.11) for document parsing, an agent SDK ( ≥ \geq 0.1.0) for LLM calls against a managed cloud LLM service, pydantic ( ≥ \geq 2.0) for structured output validation, click ( ≥ \geq 8.0) for CLI, and rich ( ≥ \geq 13.0) for progress display. Notably absent: NumPy, sentence-transformers, FAISS, scikit-learn—the embedding-based deduplication machinery common in document processing pipelines is entirely replaced by inline LLM deduplication.
blocks.zh: 五个运行时的依赖关系是:用于文档解析的python-docx(\ geq 0.8.11),用于LLM调用的代理SDK(\ geq 0.1.0),用于管理下的云LLM服务,pydantic(\\ geq 2.0)用于结构化输出验证,点击(\\\ geq 8.0)用于CLI,富(\ \ geq 13.0)用于进度显示. 特别是:NumPy、句子转换器、FAISS、scikit-learn——文件处理管道中常见的嵌入式减重机械完全被内置LLM减重取代。

blocks.en: Bedrock integration. LLM calls use the Strands Agents SDK’s BedrockModel with cross-region inference profiles ( us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1 for all calls: extraction, merge, faithfulness verification, and vision). The SDK handles streaming, retry with exponential backoff ( delay = 2 attempt + jitter \text{delay}=2^{\text{attempt}}+\text{jitter} ), and structured output via tool use.
blocks.zh: 贝德洛克整合. LLM 调用 Strands Agents SDK 的 Bedrock Model , 包含跨区域推论剖面图( us. harmic. SDK 处理流线, 重试以指数回转( 延迟 = 2 尝试 + jitter\ text{ 延迟 {2}}}\ text{ atremp\\ text{ jitter} ) , 通过工具使用进行结构化输出 。

blocks.en: Errors are classified as retryable (throttling, rate limits, transient server errors, connection timeouts) or non-retryable (authentication failures, expired tokens, malformed requests, maximum token exceeded). On retry exhaustion after 3 attempts, a PipelineError is raised with context about the failed tier and call index, enabling targeted debugging.
blocks.zh: 错误被归类为可重试(throttling,速率限制,瞬态服务器错误,连接超时)或不可重试(认证失败,过期的符号,错误的请求,最大符号超过). 在三次尝试后重新尝试疲劳时,会用上下文提出管道错误,说明故障等级和呼叫指数,从而能够进行有针对性的调试。
